title: Mind & Matter: Holistic Health Talks
description: Thrive Talks is the seminar segment of the Holistic Health Hack - Bringing together professionals, researchers, and passionate students for conversations that bridge science, wellbeing, and innovation. Hear real experiences and insights that inspire new ways to think about health - and how we can all thrive together.
content:
Join us this Saturday at the CC Theatre to learn from professionals in the medical field & passionate student speakers!

There will also be club booths and workshops in the CC foyer!! Feel free to also visit hackathon participants' booths and listen to their presentations! Don't miss out!

title: Pinktober 2026
content:
Pinktober, or Breast Cancer Awareness Month, is a time dedicated to spreading awareness, supporting those affected, and promoting early detection through education and regular checkups. It’s a reminder that breast cancer can impact anyone, and that awareness, research, and community support can save lives. Wearing pink in October symbolizes unity, hope, and the ongoing fight against breast cancer.

Scan the QR code to learn more and join us during HS lunch block at the Amphitheatre for hair donations, snacks, and music by our very own @cheresband!

Thank you @angel_wishes_nist for your leadership in advocating for breast cancer awareness!

title: PINKTOBER 2026 UPDATE
content: In light of Queen Sirikit's recent passing and to show respect in this mourning period, our Pinktober event scheduled for October 30th will be cancelled and potentially moved to a later date, we are still accepting hair donations all throughout November.
